title: Terms on the Share of the Gateway Fee Taken to Re-Commission a Remote Connection
content:
# Terms on the Share of the Gateway Fee Taken to Re-Commission a Remote Connection

**Term 1.** Where the site has stood without monitoring for more than thirty days and the building carries no maintenance agreement standing active, the tier's annual secure remote access gateway fee under the Building Automation Service Plans is taken in full — 1 times that fee — to re-commission the remote connection.

**Term 2.** Where the site has stood without monitoring for more than thirty days and the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active, half that gateway fee, that is 50 per cent of it, is taken.

**Term 3.** In every other case a quarter of the tier's annual secure remote access gateway fee, that is 25 per cent of it, is taken.

**Term 4.** The share so taken is worked to two decimal places.

Whether the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active is read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Days the site has stood without monitoring | Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | Share of the gateway fee taken |
|---|---|---|
| more than 30 | no | the whole fee |
| more than 30 | yes | half the fee |
| 30 or fewer | either | a quarter of the fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

At a tier whose annual secure remote access gateway fee is 420 USD: a site 45 days without monitoring at a building with no agreement standing active carries 420.00 USD; the same site at a building carrying an agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing active carries 210.00 USD; a site 30 days or fewer without monitoring carries 105.00 USD, whatever the building's maintenance cover.
